command.description: List configured mail accounts and connection status
Create and verify a protected SMTP/IMAP account

Remove a local mail account and its cached messages. The stored password is deleted from protected host storage (it is never readable back) and cannot be restored; re-adding the mailbox through addSmtpAccount creates a new account ID. When the account had no stored password, the result's restore field holds the removed account record and its cached messages and memberships (null when that exceeds 256 KiB), which restoreAccount re-inserts exactly; otherwise restore is null. An id without a locally stored account (including Settings → Accounts mailboxes) is refused with ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND before anything changes.

Re-insert a local mail account removed by removeAccount, exactly as captured in that result's restore field: the account record at its former position and its cached messages and memberships. Refused with ACCOUNT_EXISTS before anything changes when the account, a password for it or any of its cached rows exists again. No password is restored; the account stays without a stored credential.
List and refresh mailbox names and cached counts
Synchronize an account folder and update the local message cache

Write back a folder's local sync position (UIDVALIDITY, cursor and last sync time) captured before a sync, or delete it when previous is null. Refused with REVISION_CONFLICT before anything changes unless the stored position still equals expected. Local cache only; nothing is sent to the mail server.

Remove one message from the local cache of a folder; once no folder holds it, its cached message, recipients and attachments rows are removed too. Local cache only: the message stays on the mail server and returns with the next sync. Refused with MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND before anything changes when the folder does not cache that uid.
